business.title: Monitor construction operations
business.goal: See active jobs, cost performance, upcoming work, and profitability indicators at a glance.

steps.title: Review active projects, budget versus actual cost, upcoming tasks, and overall profitability indicators.
steps.description: The owner has a current operational overview for prioritizing attention.

outcome.statement: The owner can identify jobs requiring operational or financial attention.
evidence: Active projects and upcoming tasks are visible.
Budget versus actual cost and profitability indicators are visible.

business.title: Create a project
business.goal: Set up a construction, remodeling, or field service project with its client, location, plan, and budget.

steps.title: Locate the client from the shared customer catalog.
steps.description: A client is selected for the project.

steps.title: Create the project with its name, service address, initial status, budget, and planned start and end dates.
steps.description: A planned project is available for task coordination and cost tracking.

outcome.statement: A project is established with the information required to run the job.
evidence: The project is linked to its client and service address.
The project has a status, budget, and planned dates.

business.title: Inspect project details and progress
business.goal: Review a project's plan, tasks, costs, materials, and current delivery progress.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected.

steps.title: Review project information, task-list and timeline progress, budget versus actual cost, labor, materials, and change-order status.
steps.description: The project team has a current view of delivery progress and job cost performance.

outcome.statement: Project leaders can follow planned work and actual job performance from one project context.
evidence: Task and timeline progress are observable.
Budget, labor, material, and change-order cost information is observable.

business.title: Maintain project budget
business.goal: Set or revise the planned project budget and compare it with actual labor and material cost.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for budget maintenance.

steps.title: Review planned budget and current actual labor and material cost for the selected project.
steps.description: The estimator has the current cost comparison.

steps.title: Set or revise the planned budget for the selected project.
steps.description: The project budget is current and can be compared with actual cost.

outcome.statement: The estimator maintains an actionable planned-versus-actual job cost baseline.
evidence: The maintained project budget is recorded.
Current actual labor and material cost remains comparable to the budget.

business.title: Assign project work
business.goal: Create and assign a scheduled work task to a field worker on a selected project.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for task assignment.

steps.title: Locate an available field worker from the organization worker directory.
steps.description: A field worker is selected.

steps.title: Create a work task with its description, assigned worker, status, and due date.
steps.description: The worker has an accountable scheduled task on the project.

outcome.statement: Project work is clearly assigned for field execution.
evidence: The task is linked to the project and assigned worker.
The task has a status and due date.

business.title: Record daily work
business.goal: Update assigned task progress and record hours worked on site.

steps.title: Keep the received task or locate a task assigned to the current field worker.
steps.description: An assigned task is selected.

steps.title: Review the task's project, current status, due date, and prior recorded work.
steps.description: The worker has the current task context before recording work.

steps.title: Record the task's current progress and status for the day.
steps.description: Task progress is current for project coordination.

steps.title: Record the field worker's hours worked against the assigned task.
steps.description: Labor hours are available for project cost tracking.

outcome.statement: Field work and labor are recorded against the correct task and project.
evidence: The task has an updated progress status.
A time log links the worker, task, and recorded hours.

business.title: Record project material usage
business.goal: Record materials consumed on a project so inventory and actual job cost remain current.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for material usage.

steps.title: Locate the consumed material in the shared inventory catalog.
steps.description: A material is selected from inventory.

steps.title: Record the quantity of the selected material used by the selected project.
steps.description: Material usage contributes to inventory tracking and actual project cost.

outcome.statement: Material consumption is attributable to the project that used it.
evidence: The usage record links the project and material.
The recorded quantity is available for inventory and actual-cost tracking.

business.title: Create and approve a change order
business.goal: Document a project scope or cost change and approve it for controlled delivery and billing.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for the change order.

steps.title: Create a draft change order describing the scope, schedule, and cost impact on the selected project.
steps.description: A documented draft change order is available for decision.

steps.title: Approve the documented change order for controlled project work and billing.
steps.description: The change order is approved and its decision is traceable.

outcome.statement: Project changes are documented and approved before they affect billable work.
evidence: The change order remains linked to its project.
The approval decision and approved status are observable.

business.title: Generate a project status report
business.goal: Produce a professional client-ready status summary and identify tasks at risk of delay.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for status reporting.

steps.title: Review the project's tasks, time logs, material usage, and change orders as report evidence.
steps.description: Current project evidence is ready for report generation.

steps.title: Generate a professional project status report and an assessment of tasks at risk of delay.
steps.description: A client-ready status report and delay-risk assessment are available.

outcome.statement: The project team can communicate current job status and emerging schedule risk clearly.
evidence: The generated report is linked to the project evidence.
Tasks at risk of delay are identified in a traceable assessment.

business.title: Issue a project invoice
business.goal: Create a client invoice from approved project work and approved change orders.

steps.title: Keep the received project or locate a project from the organization project portfolio.
steps.description: A project is selected for billing.

steps.title: Review approved project work, actual usage, and approved change orders available for billing.
steps.description: The billing staff has an approved billable-work summary.

steps.title: Issue a client invoice from the approved billable-work summary.
steps.description: An invoice is issued for client billing communication.

outcome.statement: Approved work is converted into a traceable client invoice.
evidence: The invoice is linked to its project and billable-work summary.
Issued invoice details are available for the client billing summary.

business.title: View project updates
business.goal: Review clear status communication, approved changes, and schedule-risk information for own projects.

steps.title: Review projects available to the authenticated client.
steps.description: The client has a portfolio of own projects to review.

steps.title: Select one project from the client's available project portfolio for update review.
steps.description: A client project is selected.

steps.title: Review the selected project's professional status reports, approved change orders, schedule-risk communication, and current summary.
steps.description: The client has clear, current communication about the selected project.

outcome.statement: Clients can understand the current state and approved changes of their own projects.
evidence: Client-facing project status reports are available.
Approved change orders and schedule-risk communication are visible only for the client's projects.

business.title: View billing summary
business.goal: Review issued invoices and a clear billing summary for own projects.

steps.title: Review issued invoices and approved billable-work summaries for the authenticated client's projects.
steps.description: The client has a current understandable summary of project billing.

outcome.statement: Clients can review billing communication for their own projects without requiring external payment processing.
evidence: Issued invoices are listed in the client billing summary.
The summary is limited to projects belonging to the authenticated client.

profiles.landingIntent: Review the organization-wide operational picture and identify projects requiring attention.
Continue managing a project, its progress, changes, and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate field work, assign tasks, and keep material usage current.
Review assigned work and submit today's field progress, labor, and material usage.
Review project cost comparisons and maintain the planned budget.
Review approved billables and prepare project invoices.
Review published updates and billing summaries for own projects only.

dataScope.description: All operational dashboard information for the active organization.
Projects and shared client catalog records within the active organization.
Projects and change orders within the active organization.
Project reporting evidence for projects in the active organization.
Projects and their planned-versus-actual labor and material cost information within the active organization.
Projects and field workers within the active organization that are available for field-work coordination.
Projects and shared inventory materials within the active organization.
Only work tasks currently assigned to the authenticated field worker, with their directly related project context and the worker's own time logs.
Only projects related to the authenticated worker's currently assigned tasks and materials selected for that assigned work.
Projects, approved billable-work summaries, approved change orders, and invoices within the active organization.
Only projects associated with the authenticated client.
Only issued invoices and approved billable-work summaries associated with projects belonging to the authenticated client.

entities.title: Platform user
entities.description: An external platform identity used to authenticate and associate client and field-worker business records with authorized users.

storage.notes: References the platform-managed user identity. Authentication, sessions, and user administration remain platform capabilities.

entities.title: Client
entities.description: An organization client for whom projects are performed and client-facing updates and billing summaries are prepared.

storage.notes: Stable organization client registration reused by projects, client communication, and billing.

entities.title: Field worker
entities.description: An organization field-team member who can be assigned accountable work and record daily field activity.

storage.notes: Stable organization worker-directory record reused by task assignment, time recording, and assigned-work authorization.

entities.title: Service address
entities.description: The physical job-site address at which project work is performed.

storage.notes: Embedded as part of a project because the service location has no independent lifecycle in the current scope.

entities.title: Project
entities.description: A client job carrying its service location, planned schedule, budget, delivery context, and associated operational records.

storage.notes: Stable organization project registration reused by transactions, cost reporting, client communication, and billing.

entities.title: Material
entities.description: A catalog material that can be selected for project consumption and costed using its organization-maintained catalog information.

storage.notes: Stable organization material catalog registration reused by inventory positions, usage records, and job-cost reporting.

entities.title: Inventory stock
entities.description: The operational available-stock position for a catalog material used to validate and track project material consumption.

storage.notes: Operational inventory position kept outside MDM because available quantities change through usage and operational reconciliation.

entities.title: Work task
entities.description: An accountable unit of project work assigned to one field worker with a due date, current progress, and execution status.

storage.notes: Operational project-work record because assignment and progress change during delivery.

entities.title: Time log
entities.description: A daily labor record of a field worker's hours on a task, preserving the labor-cost input used in job-cost calculation.

storage.notes: Transactional daily labor evidence with an applicable labor-cost snapshot for reproducible actual-cost calculations.

entities.title: Material usage
entities.description: A recorded quantity of a catalog material consumed by a project, with the cost input used for inventory and actual job-cost calculation.

storage.notes: Transactional consumption evidence with a unit-cost snapshot and inventory-stock effect; it is not stored as master data.

entities.title: Change order
entities.description: A documented project scope, schedule, and cost change that must be approved before it becomes controlled billable work.

storage.notes: Transactional controlled-change record because its decision and project impacts are operational history.

entities.title: Change order approval
entities.description: The traceable approval decision that records which authorized user approved a change order for delivery and billing.

storage.notes: Durable authorization record retained to make approved change-order decisions auditable.

entities.title: Billable work item
entities.description: A controlled billable representation of approved project work, material usage, or an approved change order before allocation to an invoice.

storage.notes: Transactional billing-control record that preserves approval state and the durable source allocation for billable work.

entities.title: Billable work approval
entities.description: The durable authorization decision that approves a billable work item before it can be included in an invoice.

storage.notes: Durable approval record supporting the requirement that invoices use approved billable work only.

entities.title: Invoice
entities.description: An issued client billing document for approved work and approved change orders associated with one project.

storage.notes: Transactional billing record. Payment collection and external payment processing are outside this module's scope.

entities.title: Invoice line
entities.description: A durable invoice allocation that identifies the approved billable work item contributing to an issued invoice amount.

storage.notes: Transactional allocation record preserving the source-to-invoice audit trail and preventing implementation from inferring billable sources.

entities.title: Status report
entities.description: A generated professional project status summary based on current project evidence and prepared for controlled stakeholder communication.

storage.notes: Generated communication is retained as a transactional project artifact so published client communication is traceable.

entities.title: Task delay risk assessment
entities.description: A generated project schedule-risk assessment that identifies tasks likely to miss their due dates using current task and project evidence.

storage.notes: Transactional generated assessment retained with its report context and task-level risk findings.

entities.title: Task delay risk item
entities.description: A traceable task-level finding within a delay-risk assessment.

storage.notes: Durable task-level assessment item so identified delay risk is not reduced to untraceable report text.

entities.title: Operations dashboard
entities.description: An organization-wide operational projection of active projects, budget-versus-actual performance, upcoming tasks, and profitability indicators.

storage.notes: Derived organization projection; it does not duplicate project, task, time, material, or invoice transactions.

entities.title: Project progress assessment
entities.description: A consolidated project projection of schedule, tasks, labor, material usage, change-order status, and current job-cost progress.

storage.notes: Derived selected-project assessment assembled from authoritative project and operational records.

entities.title: Project cost comparison
entities.description: A selected-project comparison of planned budget against actual labor cost, actual material cost, and applicable approved change impacts.

storage.notes: Derived cost projection calculated from project budget and cost inputs retained in time logs, material usage, and approved changes.

entities.title: Daily work context
entities.description: A limited task-and-project projection providing a field worker the authorized context needed to record daily progress and labor.

storage.notes: Derived assigned-work projection that limits disclosure to the task, direct project context, and the worker's own prior labor records.

entities.title: Project reporting evidence
entities.description: A consolidated selected-project projection of tasks, time logs, material usage, and change orders used to generate a status report.

storage.notes: Derived reporting input projection; generated reports retain durable source relationships for traceability.

entities.title: Approved billable work summary
entities.description: A selected-project projection of approved uninvoiced billable work items and approved change-order amounts available for invoicing.

storage.notes: Derived billing projection based only on approved billable work and approved change orders, excluding internal cost composition from client access.

entities.title: Client project portfolio
entities.description: The authorized set of projects associated with an authenticated client.

storage.notes: Derived related-client projection enforcing that a client can select only own projects.

entities.title: Client project update
entities.description: A client-facing selected-project projection containing the current project summary, published reports, approved changes, and published schedule-risk communication.

storage.notes: Derived limited-disclosure projection that excludes internal task assignments, labor, material, budgets, actual cost, margins, and draft changes.

entities.title: Client billing summary
entities.description: A client-facing summary of issued invoices and approved billable-work summaries across the client's own projects.

storage.notes: Derived limited-disclosure projection of issued billing communication; it excludes payment processing and internal cost details.
